title: Velvety Smoky Portuguese Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Portuguese dish featuring tender lamb in a smoky and slightly sweet balsamic sauce, made halal-friendly and infused with the warmth of tadka spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the balsamic vinegar, chicken broth, and prunes, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the Dutch oven, and simmer the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer the tagine for an additional 30 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the meat is very tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
